 GTA 6 Can Be Nominated For Game Of The Year Two Days Before Anyone Is Allowed To Play It
 Forbes Follow Brian Mazique, Contributor Tue, November 17, 2026 at 1:00 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Tue, November 17, 2026 at 1:00 PM UTC GTA 6
 Credit: Rockstar How do you say your game is a major release without saying your game is a major release?
 It's when your game can be nominated for Game of the Year, even though it's only been out for a day before the eligibility deadline.
 And that's the situation with Grand Theft Auto 6 , which drops on November 19, just one day before the November 20 deadline for games to be considered for Game of the Year.
 That means the general public will have only one day to play it before the deadline, although awards evaluators may have access to advance copies.
 Advertisement Advertisement Is there any game we think is going to beat out Rockstar's giant for the top award for a single title in 2026? Let's talk GTA 6. 
 The Game Awards 2026 and GTA 6 Key Facts
 Detail

 The Game Awards rules require eligible games to be commercially available on or before Nov. 20 at 9 p.m. PT . That gives GTA 6 roughly one day inside the window, while nominees are revealed two days before launch.
 Players' Voice nominees have a later cutoff of Nov. 30.
 Is GTA 6 Eligible for The Game Awards 2026?
 Yes. GTA 6 launches Nov. 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with console copies unlocking at midnight local time. Because it ships before the cutoff, it qualifies for nomination even though it won't be out when the nominees are named.
 Advertisement Advertisement You can make the argument that neither GTA 6 nor any other game that's only been out for a day should qualify for Game of the Year consideration.
 Keighley will reveal nominees in more than 30 categories during a livestream on YouTube and Twitch at 12 p.m. ET.

 Could GTA 6 Win Game of the Year?
 But by the time the awards are handed out, and people have put in the mountains of hours they're likely to put into GTA 6, I doubt there will be very many people arguing against it winning the award.
 Advertisement Advertisement Winners will be named at the Dec. 10 ceremony at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, three weeks after GTA 6 launches. The show streams on Disney+, YouTube, Twitch and TikTok, and in Roblox for the first time.
 There have been some solid games released in 2026, well before the deadline, but nothing figures to compete with the sheer scale, awesomeness, and anticipation that come with the GTA 6 release.
 Sales projections for GTA 6 already point to a record no game has hit . The year's field also includes Resident Evil Requiem, which swept the Golden Joystick Awards .
